D1.strategy: Direct final answer formatting and precise multi-app entity resolution

D2.strategy: Direct targeted API tool invocations; never invoke completion tool for probing

D4.strategy: Step-budgeted execution: bound search retry loops, batch queries, mutate early

D5.strategy: Sliding window of 30 turns to retain execution context

D6.strategy: Strict schema conformance: raw numeric values and exact target entities

distilled_patterns.description: Agent exhausts turn limit by engaging in unbounded speculative analysis loops and repeated queries when target records are not immediately found.
distilled_patterns.effect: Impose strict 1-retry bound on speculative queries to preserve turn budget.

distilled_patterns.description: Agent misuses task completion / finish tool as an inspection or debugging probe to provoke error tracebacks, prematurely terminating the environment.
distilled_patterns.effect: Prohibit invoking completion tools for state probing; reserve exclusively for final termination.

distilled_patterns.description: Turn limit exhaustion caused by exploratory probing and unbatched linear scanning across multi-app entity graphs.
distilled_patterns.effect: Plan upfront, target specific search filters, and mutate early.
